title: Fixed Double Arm and Dial Probe Stand
description: One newly authored complete fixed articulated dial-probe-stand visual prop. Its complete raised annular bezel encloses one recessed opaque blank face; a finite lower stem and blunt axial probe extend beneath the whole case. All original numeric geometry, not a straight height-gauge beam with another face or a laboratory vessel stand renamed. One prop zero scenes, three opaque materials.
